heroTitle: Anonymous votes · Pseudonymous accounts · Openly auditable
heroBody: No login required to vote yes/no/neutral on open polls.
aboutBody: ChinaPoll combines continuous voting, anonymous participation, and public auditability into a practical public-opinion platform.
aboutPointOne: One device, one vote via a random client token and server-side uniqueness checks.
aboutPointTwo: Accounts are required only to submit a poll or comment; voting stays anonymous.
aboutPointThree: Public snapshots and hashable records for verification.
proposalBody: To add a new public poll, it should meet these minimum checks:
proposalRuleOne: It can be stated in one sentence.
proposalRuleThree: It is not a duplicate of an existing poll.
proposalRuleFour: It is relevant to public policy or civic discussion.
commentPlaceholder: Keep it public and avoid identifying details.
